reason: In TestMode3_Get, pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go:119 declares `p := prometheus.NewRegistry()`, which shadows the package-level `var p = prometheus.NewRegistry()` at dualwriter_mode1_test.go:27.
